title: Organize
subtitle: Claude suggests, you decide and Gmail does the rest.

new.title: Organize new mail
new.text: What arrived without a label. Claude finds the most precise label for each sender.

all.title: Reorganize everything
all.text: Includes what already has a label: moves each sender out of generic buckets into a label of its own.

privacy: Claude only sees the name, sender and subject, never the content. Nothing changes until you accept.

reading.title: Reading your inbox
reading.hint: It can take a couple of minutes if you have a lot of mail.

applying.title: Applying in Gmail
applying.hint: Keep the app open until it finishes.

done.title: Everything in its place
done.text: The filters are in Gmail now: new mail arrives organized even with this computer off.

nothing.title: Nothing to move
nothing.text: Everything that reaches you often already has its label.

intro_one: Claude suggests {{count, number}} label. Remove what you don't want (✕), rename it if you like and choose what happens to new mail.
intro_other: Claude suggests {{count, number}} labels. Remove what you don't want (✕), rename them if you like and choose what happens to new mail.
moving_one: {{count, number}} sender moves to another label
moving_other: {{count, number}} senders move to another label
failed_one: ({{count, number}} message could not be read)
failed_other: ({{count, number}} messages could not be read)
oldMail: Old messages get labeled or archived. To send them to the trash use Clean up or “Empty” in Labels.
